The '''Emperiax Walking Throne''' was a mid-size mobility unit and status symbol manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] for the rich and wealthy.

==History==
Originally custom-designed for a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], the Emperiax Walking Throne sold so well via special order that Arakyd made it part of the company's standard product catalogue. The design was simple itself: propelled by six legs using a simple walking algorithm, the unit was easily moved by two foot pedals located at the base. This design enabled the pilot to look like a mere passenger. An alternate version, the [[Royux Walking Throne|Royux]], removed 150 kilos of cargo space to add a pilot. The unit stood 4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and generally cost 40,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new. With the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] the new set of military contracts and low sales of Emperiax units encouraged Arakyd to discontinue the line.
